_comment: The lab's benchmark figures, quoted in reports as reference for the chosen model (plan §2.10, §4.1.4). Aggregates only, copied from docs/benchmarking-results.md §1, which is the record; update this file when a row is appended there. A model absent here is reported as having no benchmark figure. measured_languages follows plan §3.4: a language is measured once a test repo in that language meets the release bar (§3.1, 85% localization) on that model. Juice Shop (TypeScript/JavaScript) is the only test repo scored so far.
source: docs/benchmarking-results.md, OWASP Juice Shop, 97 reachable ground-truth entries
measured_languages_rule: plan §3.4: measured once a test repo in the language meets the §3.1 release bar (localization >= 85%) on this model
